meta.note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it, cross-checked against Push Square, KeenGamer, Insider Gaming, Radio Times and PlanetGTA6 (Exophase + PSNProfiles). Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry; each one names the source its facts come from, and no guide text is copied from any source.

insidergaming.name: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

keengamer.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

mobalytics.name: Mobalytics — Grand Theft Auto 6 Full Trophy List & Walkthrough

pushsquare.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

radiotimes.name: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then character quests, activities, collectibles, crime and cash, and finally the 100% checklist. KeenGamer puts the whole journey at roughly 200 hours, all in one playthrough with no online trophies needed.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing and this pops during the story. Nothing to prepare — just play the intro.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story only — it unlocks as you play through the opening chapter. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy): it is the one thing in the game that can be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story only — it unlocks as the campaign moves on.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story only — it unlocks as the campaign moves on.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story only — it unlocks as the campaign moves on.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. After it, free roam stays open, so anything you skipped can still be cleaned up — Push Square notes you can keep exploring Leonida freely once the story ends, which is when the real cleanup begins.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story only — it unlocks as you play the mission.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Story only — it unlocks as you play the mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story only — it unlocks as you play the mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story only — it unlocks as you play the mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story only — it unlocks as you play the mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only — it unlocks as you play the mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, tracked in-game under Progress once the story is done. You do not need literally everything: Push Square notes only 15 of the 18 card sets count toward it, and KeenGamer's checklist lists the exact targets — 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 8 bank vaults, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts and 30 of 40 races won. Finish the story first, then work the checklist.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind. Push Square counts 397 stunts in total — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — so you need just over half of them. Find stunt spots via Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots and track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Push Square lists 9 activities in total; dip into each one and it pops — a good early excuse to sample everything Leonida offers.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Two ranges exist — Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — and most challenges have three difficulty tiers, some locked until you meet other conditions. Find ranges via Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some charge an entry fee. Find them under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones. KeenGamer adds that the 42 drone time trials across these same 14 spots are needed for 100% completion, so racing well here pays twice.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — replaying the same race does not count. Track them under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing; most spots let you hire a car, and your own car's Rating can be raised with Mod Shop upgrades.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fairly early on Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg — fish in the marked area until you land one big enough. You need a boat with a rod; plenty can be borrowed nearby if you do not own one.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade machine and play it through to the end — any game counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission — finish his whole mission strand. Side quests like this open up as the story progresses, so check back with Andy between chapters.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Push Square names it: Maritime Disputes. Finish Kenton's strand and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Push Square names it: Hometown Heroes. Finish Billy's strand and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. KeenGamer counts eight qualifying strands; stranger missions appear as you explore, so keep an eye out for new faces while travelling between jobs.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission — finish his whole strand. Push Square points to a list of Randy's Wish List vehicle locations to help you progress it.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission — finish his whole strand. Push Square points to a Kitty Litter Lab locations list that helps with this quest.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. THE missable one: KeenGamer lists it as the only potentially missable trophy, and Mobalytics agrees there is only one possible missable in the game. After the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony, accept, and finish that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1. The other 17 spots come later; a meditation only counts once the final 'zen' animation plays. Track them under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, or on the map via Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. KeenGamer's 100% checklist mentions Bret's Target Deck — 15 hunting objectives — so meet Bret and work his hunts; study animals with binoculars whenever you meet a new species, since 100 studied animals count toward 100% completion.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game and 15 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way to A Long Road. Track them under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards; cards sold at Pawn Shops still count toward progress.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app on Jason's or Lucia's phone (hold Up). Push Square breaks the scannable spots into 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Track progress under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations — scan everything unfamiliar from the start and this comes naturally.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges; 70 are needed for 100% completion. View them all under Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges and pick the easiest 50 first, leaving the hardest for the 100% push.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. Build the wanted level with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route between three nearby shops and keep the heat on you the whole way — escaping the cops or getting caught resets the chain.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or scanning it with WAiNK. It happens naturally through the story; track it under Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles. KeenGamer notes 200 base-model vehicles are needed for 100% completion, so keep scanning.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Wait until a fight groups several enemies together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport, as KeenGamer describes it. Head to the airport, board a plane on the runway and take off.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat — that is KeenGamer's reading of this one. Expect heavy resistance around military hardware, so have an escape route ready once you are in the driver's seat.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — avoid cameras and guards spotting you — grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. KeenGamer notes the vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', and that 8 vaults are needed for 100% completion — so this pops while working toward A Long Road. Grade is Silver: KeenGamer, Insider Gaming, Radio Times and PlanetGTA6 (cross-checked against Exophase and PSNProfiles) all list it as Silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, take the cash and lose the cops.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map. Drive, fly and sail into every corner — the map fills in as you go, and the far corners are worth visiting early while you are travelling for other trophies.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. KeenGamer confirms nine gangs; hit one operation per gang and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — KeenGamer notes the exact trigger was still being confirmed, so try the beachfront spots.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. KeenGamer notes the exact method was still unconfirmed — try driving a car straight through a showroom's frontage.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. KeenGamer's method: steal the three key valuables at the alley and escape.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia — that is KeenGamer's unlock for this one. Train Strength for both characters until it is maxed.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. KeenGamer counts 500 — crimes and choices that move the profile add up over a playthrough, so it comes naturally if you play dirty and keep making your mark on Leonida.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm, per the official description. KeenGamer lists this hidden trophy's method as still unconfirmed — it reads as succeeding on a second attempt at something, so keep playing and it should surface on its own.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy whose method KeenGamer lists as unconfirmed — most likely a strange random encounter somewhere in Leonida, so explore odd corners and investigate anything unusual you stumble across.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. KeenGamer describes it as a melee drive-by elimination — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle at someone and knock them down.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; fence them through contacts until the total hits $250,000 — the same total counts toward 100% completion.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts — Push Square notes you can find shops via Touch Pad > Style. It adds up fast once you start buying cars, clothes and gear.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy them through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone — Push Square lists all eight, from the $4,000 Mitchel Auto Center to the $40,000 Atlantic Court Garage, $160,000 in total. Each adds one parking spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register a vehicle you are driving at any Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop, as long as you have a free parking spot; Scooter Bros then delivers it to you for a small fee. More spots come from buying garages.
trophies.name: On the Spot
